_architecture_note: This resolves the open question flagged during the original PRD discussion: Fast Punk and Half-Time are NOT two tempos — they are two drum-feel templates played against the SAME master click. Mid-Tempo (140), Pop Strum (150) and Ballad (80) each have their own fixed tempo (owner's calls, DECISIONS.md; Mid-Tempo's slider was removed 2026-10-04). Keep 'tempo' and 'feel template' as two distinct state fields in the app; do not hardcode BPM per feel in the UI layer.

feels.label: FAST PUNK
feels.drumFeel: straight-8th-hats, backbeat snare on 2 and 4, kick on 1 and the 'and' of 3

feels.label: HALF-TIME
feels.displayBpmNote: Shown as 90 because the drum FEEL halves — the click/master tempo is still 180.
feels.drumFeel: snare moves to beat 3 only (half-time backbeat), kick on 1, hats stay busy — classic pop-punk breakdown feel

feels.label: MID-TEMPO
feels.drumFeel: skank/offbeat-driven, kick on 1 and 3, hats on the upbeats

feels.label: POP STRUM
feels.drumFeel: driving 8th hats, backbeat snare on 2 and 4, kick on 1, 3 and the 'and' of 3, crash at the top of each 4-bar phrase

feels.label: BALLAD
feels.drumFeel: sparse: kick on 1 and the 'and' of 3, rim click on 3, quarter-note hats

uiRequirement: When Feel = Mid-Tempo is selected, render a tempo stepper/slider (120-150, default 140) in place of (or alongside) the static BPM label the mockup currently shows. Fast Punk / Half-Time show a fixed, non-editable BPM readout.
